name: Amazon EWR4 Fulfillment Center Robbinsville NJ

fieldNotes.truckGate: Secured, fenced truck yard on the NE dock side. Driver reviews and a Command Security 'Amazon - Robbinsville - EWR4' guard post confirm a manned checkpoint; drivers present BOL/appointment on arrival and report 30+ min checkpoint waits. Street View does not enter the truck yard (private/gated) — only the SW employee perimeter and Sharon Rd are publicly driveable.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred manned booth at the truck gate (Command Security staffs the post; standard for a 1.2M sqft Amazon FC). The booth structure could not be individually resolved in satellite because the gate sits deep inside the yard behind a tree buffer — hence medium confidence on the physical shack vs. remote kiosk.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Driver reviews report 30+ minute checkpoint queues; tight single-gate intake.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous row of trailers backed into dock doors along the full ~500m NE wall; 50+ band is conservative for a 1.2M sqft robotics FC.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Wide truck court / drop yard on the NE side holding many parked trailers; 25-50 band estimated from overhead trailer count.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Matrix Business Park at the edge of Robbinsville Twp, bordered by active farmland and a tree nursery on the N/NE; edge-of-town industrial classified Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated; exact lane count at the gate not visible in available imagery.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single EWR4 building. Adjacent large warehouses (incl. a heavily solar-roofed building to the south) are separate Matrix Business Park parcels/companies, not part of this property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad observed in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
